findings.claim: FY2025 10-K: Channel Development was 5% of revenue; large portion runs on a licensed model via Nestlé Global Coffee Alliance; North America 74%, International 21%.
findings.excerpt: Revenues from our reportable operating segments as a percentage of total net revenues for fiscal 2025 were as follows: North America (74%), International (21%), and Channel Development (5%).

findings.claim: Starbucks and Boyu closed China JV on 2026-03-30; Boyu funds took 60%, Starbucks 40%; China company-operated stores moved to licensed model.
findings.source: Business Wire: Starbucks and Boyu Capital Finalize Joint Venture

findings.claim: 10-Q (quarter ended 2026-03-29): China JV stores transitioned to licensed operating model; equity-method accounting.
findings.excerpt: our share of income from the joint venture, recognized as income from equity investees under the equity method of accounting, and recording revenues related to product sales and royalties. The disposal group was deconsolidated from our financial statements and will be reported as part of our licensed portfolio in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
